blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Eligible UPLIFT beneficiaries can receive up to ₱8,000 in government cash assistance starting Friday, Oct. 30, but the amount and payout date depend on their beneficiary group, monthly salary credit, and previous payments. The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) has scheduled the third and fourth tranches of its Unified Package for Livelihoods, Industry, Food, and Transport (UPLIFT) program for late October and November 2026. Qualified Social Security System (SSS) members and eligible households can receive their assistance through different payment channels. Here is what beneficiaries need to know about the payout schedule, amounts, and requirements. […]... Keep on reading: Uplift payout starts Oct. 30: Who gets ₱4,000 or ₱8,000, and when?
